title: Companion offline current-view copy
description: Requires the explicit private Gateway/proxy receipts and a warm mounted run; never injects client or cache state.

proofTargets.claim: The actual offline Android clipboard preserves the displayed run URL without a worker command.

begin.intent: Record the actual owned outage and current instruction history.

visible.intent: The retained source run is still displayed while offline.

menu.intent: Describe the current retained run without refreshing it.

image.intent: Retain the offline view and its available Copy action.

copy.intent: Copy the displayed run even while its Gateway is unavailable.

clipboard.intent: Measure the actual OS clipboard without restarting Companion.

clipboard-proved.intent: The native clipboard must preserve the exact run selection.

proof.intent: Compare the offline clipboard and instruction counters.

proved.intent: Offline sharing must keep the same URL and send no instruction.

close-menu.intent: Return to the retained run after copying.

hud-image.intent: Retain the offline view and its available Copy action.
